paper_title: Brief Announcement: Exact Size Counting in Uniform Population Protocols in Nearly Logarithmic Time
statement: Ω(n) is a clear lower bound on the number of states required for any protocol computing the exact population size, since log n bits are required merely to write the number n. (Note that our protocol uses 60 log n bits.) It is an open question if there exists a uniform polylog-time, O(n)-state population protocol for exact size computation.
